content: iOS PWA installability (2025-2026): iOS 16.4+ supports install via Safari/Chrome/Edge share menu. Web manifest needs display:standalone plus icons (192, 512, 512 maskable), BUT iOS Safari ignores manifest icons and requires separate <link rel='apple-touch-icon'> tag - must ship both. Missing/inaccessible icon blocks install. No install prompt API on iOS (unlike Android beforeinstallprompt) - must instruct users via in-app UI to use Share > Add to Home Screen.
